notes.title: First hotfix is online!
notes.notes:
Added VSync option (it was enabled by default earlier).

VERY IMPORTANT: If you are a Windows 10 Creators Update user, the game could be broken (black screen but game is running and music is playing).

To fix it:

    Alt+Enter
    Options
    Enable VSync
    Then go fullscreen (if you want to...)


And also, now you can speed up gameplay by holding Space (when VSync is disabled). If you're like "OMG the game is so slow!" - this feature is for you! ːgetdizzyː

Happy alien crushing!
